newsitem.title: UK: ITV & C4 join forces on digital terrestrial TV.
newsitem.headline: ITV & C4 join forces on digital terrestrial TV.

text.p: The ITV commercial television network and Channel Four said they have set up a new company to run the digital terrestrial TV network earmarked for them.
The company - Digital 3 and 4 Ltd - submitted an application to the Independent Television Commission (ITC) for the second digital terrestrial television multiplex, they said in a statement.
Under the Broadcasting Act, the second multiplex has been reserved for the ITV companies, Channel Four and Teletext.
The first multiplex has been set aside for the BBC.
Friday is the deadline for applicants to sumbit their proposals to run the four remaining multiplexes.
Each multiplex can carry some six channels. Digital terrestrial television, offering a total of around 36 channels is expected to begin in mid-1998.
